scenes.title: 04-p1
lines: The game Quake stores that information at locations on the wall. A texture is a digital image supplying a pattern such as bricks; a lightmap is a separate image recording illumination across the surface. Separate the pattern image from the lighting image used on the same wall.

scenes.title: 04f-p7
lines: Filtering reads stored information stably rather than inventing missing detail. Higher quality may require reading and blending more samples. Where data is gathered and the order of processing therefore also matter.

scenes.title: 08-p10
lines: Light remaining after a source is disabled can also reflect different update times. Static indirect light may be stored while direct lighting is updated dynamically. Next, record depth to determine where that changing direct light is blocked.

scenes.title: 09b-p1
lines: That cost is also connected to the order of material and lighting evaluation. Forward rendering evaluates the material and relevant lights while drawing a surface. Once it handles a wall pixel, it completes the lighting calculation there to produce its color.
